title: Lightsmith: an open, GPU-native photonics suite built for AI agents
description: Lightsmith describes a photonics problem once, as typed JSON, and solves it with Mie, T-matrix, DDA, FDTD, TMM, RCWA, FDE, EME, FDFD, PWE and S-matrix circuit solvers on CPU or GPU, with differentiable inverse design. Every result uses the same units and conventions and carries provenance, so methods can be cross-checked directly. Python, CLI and MCP interfaces are JSON in, JSON out.
